artworks.title: The Unicorn Purifies the Water with Its Horn
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22 × 39.7 cm (8 11/16 × 15 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of animals gathered around a unicorn by a stream. The scene depicts a unicorn near a stream, surrounded by a variety of animals in different poses. In the background, there is a landscape with a stone bridge, trees, and distant cliffs topped with structures.

artworks.title: Tobias and the Angel (The Little Tobias)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, one with wings, crossing a stream on smooth stones. A small dog follows them. In the background, dense trees obscure the horizon, birds fly in the sky, and clouds stretch horizontally. The artwork features intricate details in the trees and clouds, using a monochromatic palette of black, white, and gray. The emphasis is on textures in the trees, sky, and water reflections. Further back, a person guides cattle across the water.

artworks.title: Tobias and the Angel (The Large Tobias)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 24.5 x 25.6 cm (9 5/8 x 10 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The view shows two figures standing close to us. One figure has wings. In the background, there is a horizon line with hills and man-made structures. The scene includes detailed trees with leaves depicted by fine strokes. The color palette is primarily sepia and dark brown. Large clouds are visible in the sky. Elegant calligraphy is present at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 34.5 × 39.5 cm (13 9/16 × 15 9/16 in.)
mount: 35 × 40 cm (13 3/4 × 15 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a nocturnal landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is low, obscured by large trees casting a silhouette against the sky. A dark sky features a prominent moon reflecting on water extending into the horizon. The water on the left adds depth. Moonlight illuminates the scene, including figures in the center surrounded by foliage. On the right, a group gathers around a fire, providing bright illumination against the dark. Fine brushstrokes render detailed light and shadow, with earthy tones and deep blues creating a dramatic visual impact.

artworks.title: Beheading of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image depicts six individuals in various poses. Most are positioned around a central figure holding an object. One individual to the left wears a plumed hat and points towards the central figures. The individuals display unique facial features, hairstyles, and clothing. They are shown holding swords. The background is dark with no additional context.

artworks.title: The Mocking of Ceres
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nighttime scene featuring a cloaked figure, a child, and a young woman engaged with a candlelit sphere. The scene has lush foliage and a background of trees and a wooden structure. The cloaked figure holds a candle illuminating the faces of those present, adding dramatic lighting to the scene. There is a wheel on the right, possibly part of a spinning wheel, suggesting domestic activity. The setting is detailed, from the texture of the fabric to the delicate leaves on the branches. The contrast between the deep shadows and the softly lit characters adds depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Mercury in the House of Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Multiple individuals are in a dimly lit room with a rustic atmosphere. On the left, a woman stands draped in a gown, holding fabric. In the background, another figure carries a basket. In the middle, a young man sits on a chair wearing a shirt and cloth with a hat. To the right, an older man reclines in a chair with a beard, wearing a flowing garment. The room is cluttered with various items, including a hanging basket, pots, and a table with a display. The background shows a ladder and wooden beams supporting the ceiling.

artworks.title: Baco (Bacchus)
artworks.medium: etching on heavy laid paper [first edition impression printed in the Calcografia in 1778-79]
artworks.description: The etching depicts a group of men sitting closely together. In the center is a nude figure with a cloth draped over their lap, wearing a crown of vine leaves and holding a large drinking vessel. Surrounding this central figure are other men seated or kneeling, some wearing hats and loose clothing. Their facial expressions vary, with expressions ranging from smiling to contemplative. One man to the right holds a jug. In the foreground, a figure is hunched over a large jar or barrel. In the background are mountains, trees, and a natural setting.

artworks.title: El famoso Americano, Mariano Ceballos (The Famous American, Mariano Ceballos)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper [edition impression printed by Gaulon in Bordeaux in 1825]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bullfight scene. The image depicts a moment within a bullfighting ring. In the foreground, a bull is bucking energetically, with a costumed figure on its back, likely a bullfighter, poised with a lance. Another bull is seen on the right, while bystanders or assistants are managing the scene. The background shows a crowded arena filled with sketch-like spectators. Shadows and textures suggest various moods and the pressure of the performance. The lines and tones add depth, emphasizing the chaos and action in the bullring.

artworks.title: Picador Caught by a Bull
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper [edition impression printed by Gaulon in Bordeaux in 1825]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bullfighting scene in an arena. The drawing illustrates a moment where a bull is interacting with figures on horses who are engaging with the bull using long spears. The scene is set within a bullring, with the audience barely discernible as a crowd in the background. The drawing is in monochrome, emphasizing the contrasts between light and shadow. The composition captures the tension and chaos, with dynamic lines conveying movement and struggle. The figures are outlined with varying degrees of detail, adding to the sense of turmoil and excitement in bullfighting events.

artworks.title: Dibersion de España (Spanish Entertainment)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper [edition impression printed by Gaulon in Bordeaux in 1825]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bullfighting scene. The image features several bulls in an arena surrounded by a crowd of spectators. The drawing captures a dynamic moment, with three bulls running at the top, while one bull is engaged with a cloth at the bottom. Figures cluster to the right. The composition reflects the chaotic energy of traditional Spanish bullfighting, with detailed expressions and postures in fine lines. The bustling crowd encircles the action, enhancing the feeling of movement and excitement within the space.

artworks.title: Bullfight in a Divided Ring
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper [edition impression printed by Gaulon in Bordeaux in 1825]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bullfighting scene. The image captures the action within a bullfighting arena. In the foreground, a bull is depicted in motion, with an individual engaging with the bull. The background shows an audience of spectators along the walls of the arena. Other figures and bulls are seen in the background, with one bull on the ground. The crowd's expressions and the bustling atmosphere emphasize the tension of the event. The artwork is rendered in shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Sylvester (Douglas) Lord Glenbervie; Katherine Anne (North) Glenbervie; Frederic (North) Earl of Guilford; Frederic Sylvester Douglas
artworks.medium: lithograph, four portraits printed on one sheet
artworks.description: The image features four portraits arranged in a grid layout, each depicting a different individual. In the top left corner is Katherine Anne (North), Lady Glenbervie, shown from the waist up. To her right is Sylvester (Douglas), Lord Glenbervie, in a profile view. In the bottom left is The Hon. Frederic Sylvester Douglas, while in the bottom right is Frederic (North), Earl of Guildford. The portraits are set against a plain background, with minimal details like chairs. The individuals are depicted with a light, sketched quality, focusing on their features and clothing.

artworks.title: The Poet Virgil Suspended in a Basket
artworks.description: This print depicts a group of people gathered outside a building, looking upward. At the top of the print, a man appears to sit in a basket that hangs from the side of the building. This man wears a round cap or turban and robes with wide sleeves and a puffed neckline. The people in the crowd below look up towards the basket, some pointing towards it. The crowd includes men and women in long robes, tunics, or dresses. Many of them wear different kinds of caps, and some have swords attached to their sides. On the left, there is also a child in the crowd, looking towards a woman next to him. In the center, a small dog is sniffing the rocky ground. The surroundings include more buildings on the right, including a church steeple, visible against a sky with birds in flight.

artworks.title: Title Plate
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a straight-on perspective of an architectural structure with an engraved facade displaying text. The horizon is not clearly defined as the architectural elements dominate the upper part of the scene, with a large plaque at the center. The style features finely detailed etching, visible in the shading, line work, stone textures, and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. Stone steps lead to the structure, where two figures are depicted. In the distance, there are silhouettes of domes, spires, and columns above a wall, suggesting a cityscape.

artworks.title: La Torre di Malghera
artworks.description: The image shows a calm expanse of water with low mountains or hills in the distance. A tall tower is on the right side of the image. The building style is illustrated with fine line work, showcasing textures like stone and plaster. The color palette is monochrome, with varying shades of grey depicting light and shadow. Small boats and figures can be seen on the water, with additional boats and structures along the shore. Clouds in the background contrast with the detailed landscape.

artworks.title: Mestre
artworks.description: The image depicts a canal scene with buildings and trees on both sides. There are figures engaging in various activities near the water. Boats can be seen on the canal. The sky has long, horizontal clouds. The etching uses delicate lines to capture architectural details, people, and the surroundings. The overall color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Al Dolo
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a canal with traditional buildings on both sides. A church with a tall spire is on the right, and grand residential structures are on the left. Small boats with figures are in the water, and individuals are walking along the shoreline. The scene is detailed using etching techniques with a monochromatic color palette of black and white. The sky has delicate cloud formations drawn with swirling lines.

artworks.title: Ale Porte del Dolo
artworks.description: The image shows a canal or waterway with boats docked along the edge. A detailed boat with people is closest to the viewer. Behind the boats are large multi-story buildings lining the water's edge. A tall steeple rises above the buildings on the horizon. The sky is cloudless with textured engravings. The monochrome composition consists of etched lines in black and gray. Trees are interspersed with the buildings.

artworks.title: Le Porte Del Dolo
artworks.description: The image shows a canal and surrounding buildings from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, with trees in the distance above the canal's lock gate structure. The detailed artwork features fine lines depicting textures of stone buildings and a wooden canal boat. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of gray. Figures are visible near the canal, some wearing long dresses and hats, with one person selling goods at a table. More people are scattered along the quay and inside buildings in the background.

artworks.title: Pra della Valle
artworks.description: The image shows an urban square with historical architecture. The square is bordered by classical buildings, including one with a tall bell tower on the left. The right side features buildings with arches, potentially indicating an arcade or covered walkways. There are figures throughout the square engaged in various activities, including conversations, movement, and observation. A horse-drawn carriage is in the foreground. The drawing is detailed, capturing the architectural elements and the lively atmosphere of the square. The background fades into an urban landscape with trees and distant structures.

artworks.title: S. Giustina in pra della Vale
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a busy open area with people engaged in various activities. There is a grand building in the distance with large domes and a central feature. The perspective is at eye level, showcasing intricate line work, architectural details, and a series of arched buildings on the left side. The style includes detailed linework with hatching and cross-hatching for depth. The color palette is grayscale to highlight the line work and create a historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: View of a Town on a River Bank
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside landscape with rustic buildings along the riverbank, a curved tree in the center. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes, detailed natural elements and architecture, and a monochromatic color palette of black and gray. Two figures are near the riverside, and structures populate the distant skyline with a prominent spire.
